summary: Tiptree Inc. filed an 8-K to amend its prior Agreement and Plan of Merger for the sale of its subsidiary, The Fortegra Group, Inc., to DB Insurance Co., Ltd. The original Merger Agreement was entered into on September 26, 2025. The amendment removes the condition requiring NYDFS approval for the acquisition of control of South Bay Acceptance Corp., a Fortegra subsidiary, and instead requires Fortegra to use reasonable best efforts to surrender that premium finance agency license by May 5, 2026 as a condition to close. The transaction structure remains a merger of Merger Sub into Fortegra, making it a wholly owned subsidiary of Purchaser. No price or premium terms are disclosed, but the existing Merger Agreement otherwise remains in effect. Watch for timely surrender of the license and regulatory clearance in other jurisdictions.
